verdict.rationale: Flagsmith documents per-environment flag configuration with unlimited environments, so a non-production environment can be targeted. RBAC can restrict who modifies production environments, and the entire platform can be run locally via Docker as a fully isolated instance. The CLI and MCP server can manage environments programmatically, which suits AI-driven testing. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that non-production environments are isolated sandboxes with separate identity and segment data, agent-specific guidance on scoping keys to a test environment, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
